user_query: I am planning a surprise party for my best friend. Can you suggest a date when most of our mutual friends will be available based on their working days? Additionally, provide me with the working days for the next two weeks. Also, evaluate the expression '30 + 20 - 10' to determine the number of guests we can invite.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the working days for each mutual friend for the next two weeks.
Analyze the availability of mutual friends based on retrieved working days to suggest the best date for the surprise party.
Evaluate the expression '30 + 20 - 10' to determine the maximum number of guests that can be invited.
